vb_textbox.text: I started by focussing on the pointy hats and the darker hats seemed to work well but as the game progressed, I had to adapt so every time the mushroom points fell lower, I would switch to choosing the opposite side gnome and kept on choosing that side until the points fell again, then I would shift to the other gnome. I also think it is important to react fast with the space bar. The speed may affect number of mushrooms?
